events.title: COPLEY COMEDY SERIES FEATURING BENKER & PRESTON
events.description:
JOIN TIM BENKER, MIKE PRESTON AND HOST STEVE COCHRAN FOR A NIGHT OF BIG LAUGHS. 
Subscriber pre-sale: April 29 at 10 a.m.
Public on-sale: May 1 at 10 a.m. 
When it comes to comedy, Chicago is a driving force. The Windy City area has produced some of the biggest names in improv, sketch and stand-up comedy in the country. So we’ve tapped into the talent pool of professional stand-ups that call Chicagoland home when they’re not touring the nation doing what they do best: making people laugh. 
Welcome to the Copley Comedy Series. On select Saturday nights through November 2026, amazingly talented professional stand-ups take the stage in the intimate 165-seat Copley Theatre. From Zanies, the Improv and Chicago Theatre to the Fillmore, Symphony Hall, HBO and Nexflix, these seasoned stand ups are coming to Aurora intent on showing you a good time – interpret that as you will. 
There’s no drink minimum. Come early and hang out in the very cool Copley Bar and just have some fun. 
November 7’s line-up:
Headliner: Tim Benker
Featuring: Mike Preston
Host: Steve Cochran
